settlements.title: NYC Senior Care $15 Co-Pay Settlement (Bianculli v. City of New York)
settlements.estimated_payout: Full or partial reimbursement of the $15 co-pays paid for eligible medical services under the GHI Senior Care Plan between January 1, 2022 and January 31, 2023. The amount depends on the co-pays each eligible member paid.

settlements.title: Pork Antitrust Consumer Settlements (Indirect Purchasers)
settlements.estimated_payout: Six settlements totaling $117.065 million (Clemens $13.5M, Hormel $4.465M, Seaboard $10M, Triumph $4.1M, Tyson $85M; Agri Stats agreed to business-practice reforms and pays no money). Cash payment via claim; no fixed per-person amount is stated.

settlements.title: AMN Healthcare Language Interpretation Privacy (CIPA) Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $4.5 million Settlement Fund; class members who file a valid claim share the fund (pro rata; no fixed per-person amount is stated).

settlements.title: FCA US 3.6L Engine Valve Train Warranty Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: An automatic warranty extension for certain valve train system components (Valve Rocker Arm, Valve Stem Oil Seal, Valve Tappet); plus reimbursement (by claim) for monies previously paid to diagnose or repair those components. No fixed dollar figure is stated.

settlements.title: Costa Del Mar Sunglasses Warranty Fee Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $4,095,000 Settlement Fund; an automatic pro rata cash payment for each eligible warranty repair (the warranty processing fee was $11.95 plus tax per claim). Payment amount is determined after attorneys' fees and expenses (up to $1,200,000 requested) and administration costs are deducted from the Fund.

settlements.title: Mortgage Investors Group Data Breach Settlement
FirstCash Military Lending Act (CFPB) Settlement
Mental Health Association Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: One-time $40.00 alternate cash payment (no proof), OR reimbursement of up to $5,000.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses plus up to three hours of lost time at $25.00 per hour ($75.00 max). Alternatively, three years of free credit monitoring with $1 million in identity theft insurance. Benefits subject to a $300,000.00 cap with pro rata reduction.

settlements.title: Raging Waters Processing Fee Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The amount of the Settlement Payment will depend on the proportion of total processing fees paid by each claimant, the number of eligible claimants, and other expenses associated with the Settlement.

settlements.title: International Shoppes Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Documented out-of-pocket losses reimbursement up to $4,000.00; OR an alternative cash payment expected to be $50.00 (may be smaller depending on total claims); plus two years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete credit monitoring with $1 million of financial fraud insurance. Aggregate cap of $500,000.00.

settlements.title: Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences (ACPHS) Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: One-time cash payment of $25.00 (no documentation required); or reimbursement for documented out-of-pocket losses not to exceed $5,000.00 and lost time at $20.00 per hour for up to four hours ($80.00 max); plus two years of CyEx Financial Shield Total credit monitoring with $1 million of financial fraud insurance.

settlements.title: CUSO Financial Services Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Two years of three-bureau credit monitoring, dark web scanning, $1M reimbursement insurance, and identity restoration services provided by IDX; reimbursement of documented losses up to $5,000; California Statutory Payment up to $100 for California residents; and a Residual Cash Payment up to $599 (pro rata).

settlements.title: Regional Urology Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Class members may choose (1) medical monitoring (one year of CyEx Medical Shield Complete with $1 million identity theft insurance) and/or reimbursement for documented out-of-pocket losses up to $5,000.00, OR (2) a single $40.00 cash payment.

settlements.title: LiveHealth Online Data Privacy Settlement (Polk v. American Well Corp.)
settlements.estimated_payout: Approximately $51.14 to $102.29 per Settlement Class Member, paid pro rata from a $2,037,751.46 settlement fund.

settlements.title: Peco Foods Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Ordinary out-of-pocket losses reimbursed up to $1,000.00 total; extraordinary losses up to $5,000.00 total; residual cash payment up to $550.00 (pro-rated); plus three years of triple-bureau credit monitoring. Total settlement fund $950,000.00.

settlements.title: Highland Health Systems Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A one-time $85.00 Pro Rata Cash Payment (amount may vary), OR reimbursement of up to $5,000.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses. All class members may also elect two years of CyEx Medical Shield Total (three-bureau credit monitoring + $1 million medical identity theft insurance). Paid from a $650,000.00 Settlement Fund.

settlements.title: Fort Wayne Medical Education Program (FWMEP) Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Reimbursement of ordinary out-of-pocket losses up to $500.00; extraordinary losses (identity theft/fraud) up to $5,000.00; lost time up to four hours at $20.00 per hour ($80.00 max); OR a one-time $40.00 cash payment (no proof). Group 1 (SSN compromised): two years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete + $1 million financial fraud insurance; Group 2: two years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete + $1 million medical identity theft insurance.

settlements.title: High 5 Games / High 5 Casino Social Casino Settlement (Washington)
settlements.estimated_payout: A pro-rata share of a Settlement Fund of at least $12,000,000 and up to $30,000,000, paid electronically or by check. Your share depends on the total dollar amount of your in-app purchases during the Class Period, how many valid claims are submitted, and the total amount Defendants pay into the fund.

settlements.title: New York City DOC Strip Search Settlement (Lewis v. City of New York)
settlements.estimated_payout: Pro rata cash from a $28,000,000 Distribution Amount; each claimant's share is the number of times they were strip searched (upon arrival at Manhattan Court Division after already being strip searched before leaving Rikers) divided by the total such searches by all claimants. Attorneys' fees, service awards, and administrative costs are NOT deducted from the $28,000,000.

settlements.title: Wellstar Health System Website Pixel Data Privacy Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A pro rata (equal share) cash payment from the $4,250,000 Settlement Fund; the exact amount is determined after deducting notice/administration costs, Court-approved Service Awards, and attorneys' fees and expenses.

settlements.title: ConnectOnCall Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Two years of Dark Web and Medical Data Monitoring (CyEx Medical Shield Complete, including up to $1,000,000 medical identity theft insurance), AND Cash Payment A – Documented Losses up to $5,000, OR Cash Payment B – Alternate Cash up to a maximum of $75.

settlements.title: Brooks v. TransUnion Bankruptcy Credit Reporting Settlement (FCRA)
settlements.estimated_payout: No Bankruptcy Group: automatic $100 (do nothing), or approximately $1,000 if a Valid Claim is submitted. Aged Bankruptcy Group: approximately $350, but only if a claim is submitted. Amounts depend on the number of claims and may be higher or lower. $8,310,000 Settlement Fund.

settlements.title: University of Hawai'i Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cash Payment A - Extraordinary Documented Losses: up to $5,000 per Settlement Class Member with reasonable documentation of fraud/identity-theft losses traceable to the Data Incident; OR Cash Payment B - Alternate Cash: estimated $50.00 (subject to pro rata adjustment). Plus optional one year of CyEx Medical Data Monitoring.

settlements.title: Costa Del Mar Sunglasses Repair Fee Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Automatic pro rata cash payment from the $23,900,000 Settlement Fund for each eligible repair; individual amount determined after administration costs and attorneys' fees/expenses are deducted.

settlements.title: Altrua HealthShare / Crown (Health Admins) TCPA Unwanted Calls Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to a $700.00 Settlement Payment; maximum fund of $1,100,000.00. Payments may be reduced pro rata so total does not exceed the Aggregate Cap of $1,100,000.00.

settlements.title: Central Maine Healthcare Data Security Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cash Payment A – Documented Losses: up to $5,000 per Settlement Class Member with reasonable documentation; OR Cash Payment B – Alternate Cash: estimated $50 pro rata cash without documentation; AND one year of free Medical Records Monitoring. Cash payments subject to pro rata increase or decrease.

settlements.title: Furniture Mart, USA (FMUSA) Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Three years of CyEx Identity Defense Complete credit monitoring with $1 million in identity theft insurance; up to $4,500.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses; up to four hours of lost time at $25.00 per hour (maximum $100.00); or a one-time flat $75.00 cash payment with no proof required.

settlements.title: Dr. Squatch "All Natural" Product Claims Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Pro-rata cash payment from a $9,000,000 Settlement Fund; each payment is calculated based on the number of Valid Claims submitted, so the exact per-claim amount is not fixed.

settlements.title: Sutton v. TED Foundation VPPA Data Privacy Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Automatically two free months of TED Membership (estimated at least $10.00 value), or instead file a claim for a $5.00 cash payment (subject to pro rata reduction from a $350,000.00 fund) or donate that payment to TED.

settlements.title: John Deere Repair Services Antitrust Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A share of the $99 million cash Settlement (plus interest accruing since January 15, 2026). The notice does not state a fixed per-person amount; the total Settlement value (including injunctive relief) is estimated between $392.9 million and $747 million. Filing a claim form is the only way to receive money.

settlements.title: California Casualty Group Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Two years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete credit monitoring with $1 million fraud insurance; plus either reimbursement of up to $4,000.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses, or a one-time $50.00 alternative cash payment (no proof required).

settlements.title: Palomar Health Medical Group Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Either up to $5,000 for documented losses or an estimated $60 cash payment, plus two years of credit monitoring.

settlements.title: Steel Warehouse Company Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: One year of CyEx Financial Shield Complete credit monitoring with $1 million fraud insurance, plus one cash option: up to $5,000.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses, up to $60.00 for lost time (up to 3 hours at $20.00/hour), or a one-time $40.00 alternative cash payment.

settlements.title: Susan B. Allen Memorial Hospital (SBAMH) Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $100.00 total in cash: reimbursement of documented out-of-pocket losses up to $100.00 and/or attested lost time up to four hours at $25.00 per hour (maximum $100.00), with a $100.00 aggregate cap across both cash claim types. Plus two years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete credit monitoring with $1 million of medical identity theft insurance.

settlements.title: Brevard Skin & Cancer Center Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: One year of CyEx Medical Shield Complete medical data monitoring with $1 million of medical identity theft insurance, plus your choice of Option A (reimbursement up to $2,500.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses, with proof) or Option B ($45.00 one-time cash payment, no proof required).

settlements.title: WPM Pathology Laboratory Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Reimbursement of up to $400.00 for documented ordinary out-of-pocket expenses; up to $4,000.00 for documented extraordinary out-of-pocket losses; up to $80.00 for lost time (up to four hours at $20.00 per hour); OR a one-time alternative cash payment of $45.00. All class members may also receive two years of CyEx Identity Defense Complete credit monitoring with $1 million in identity theft insurance.

settlements.title: Sugared + Bronzed Unwanted Text Messages (TCPA) Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Estimated between $110.00 and $222.00 per approved claimant — a pro-rata share of a $750,000.00 non-reversionary Settlement fund; the actual amount may be more or less depending on the number of valid, approved claims.

settlements.title: Summit Medical Group Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cash Payment A: up to $2,500.00 for actual, documented out-of-pocket losses; Cash Payment B: up to $45.00 for lost time ($15.00/hour for up to three hours); plus two years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete with $1 million of medical identity theft insurance.

settlements.title: Modernizing Medicine (ModMed) Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $5,000.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses (Cash Payment A), OR a one-time estimated $75.00 cash payment with no documentation (Cash Payment B); plus two years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete medical data monitoring with $1 million of medical identity theft insurance.

settlements.title: Community Dental Care Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cash Payment A - Documented Losses: up to $5,000.00 for actual, unreimbursed, documented out-of-pocket losses (for losses occurring between December 20, 2024, and October 19, 2026); OR Cash Payment B - Alternative Cash: a one-time $50.00 payment with no proof required. All Class Members may also enroll in two years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete medical and credit monitoring with $1 million of medical identity theft insurance.

settlements.title: Hiller v The Money Source, Inc.
settlements.estimated_payout: TMS will establish a Settlement Fund of $1,500,000.00. A pro rata payment from the Settlement Fund will be made to all Settlement Class Members, based on the number of calls each Settlement Class Member received after requesting that TMS stop, after deducting administration costs, Court-awarded attorneys' fees, costs and expenses, and the service award to the Plaintiff. No fixed per-person amount is stated. If you are entitled to an amount greater than $2,000, you must first provide the Settlement Administrator with your taxpayer identification number (W-9) or you may be subject to backup withholding.

settlements.title: CAMC Hernia Surgery Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Defendants pay up to $40,000,000, with $30,000,000 in a Guaranteed Payments Fund distributed evenly among Settlement Class Members and $10,000,000 in a Contingent Payments Fund for members who file a Claim Form and show specific medical complications.

settlements.title: Star Casualty Total Loss Fees Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $79.85 in unpaid Title Transfer Fees and Tag Transfer Fees ($75.25 + $4.60), and/or repayment of improper Excess Storage and Towing deductions capped at $25 per day for up to 8 days ($200 maximum), plus prejudgment interest. Recoveries are offset by any amounts previously paid for the same fees or storage.

settlements.title: On Q Financial Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Settlement Payments and Expanded Identity Theft and Fraud Monitoring Services paid out of a $1,250,000 Settlement Fund; the site does not publish a per-person amount.

settlements.title: American Vision Partners Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Reimbursement of documented out-of-pocket losses subject to an individual cap of $3,000 per claimant, or, as an alternative, a pro rata cash payment whose size moves with the number of claims and the Settlement Fund cap.

settlements.title: Kia Optima & Sportage Window Regulator Settlement
MCNA Dental Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $2,500 per individual Claim for unreimbursed Documented Out-of-Pocket Losses, out of a total of up to $250,000 for such Cash Payments; payments are reduced pro rata if the total of all Valid Claims exceeds that amount. Two years of Medical Data Monitoring is provided automatically without submitting a Claim Form.

settlements.title: EFS Advisors / Aviben Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $2,500.00 per claimant for documented out-of-pocket losses, or an alternative one-time cash payment of $50.00; plus one year of three-bureau credit monitoring including at least $1,000,000.00 in theft protection insurance. An Aggregate Cap of $850,000.00 covers all payments, so cash is reduced pro rata if claims exceed it.

settlements.title: SitusAMC Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A Flat Cash payment estimated to be $75.00, or reimbursement of Documented Losses up to a maximum of $5,000.00; class members who resided in California between November 12, 2025 and November 22, 2025 may claim an additional $50.00 California Statutory Payment. One year of credit monitoring with $1,000,000 identity theft insurance is included.

settlements.title: VSL#3 Probiotic $20 Million Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $20 per unit of VSL#3 purchased, subject to pro rata adjustment. Without proof of purchase, one (1) unit per household; with proof of purchase, the greater of three (3) units or the number proven, up to 40 units in total or $800.

settlements.title: Highlands Oncology Group Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $4,250.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses, or a one-time $50.00 cash payment instead with no proof required; all Class Members may also enroll in three years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete.

settlements.title: Talkdesk Washington Job Posting Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: An equal share of the Class Fund, up to a maximum of $5,000.00 per claimant.

settlements.title: Jail Release Card Settlement (Rapid Financial & Axiom Bank)
settlements.estimated_payout: A minimum award of $15.00 plus three times the fees incurred on the release card(s), from a $4,200,000 settlement fund; claims are paid pro rata if what remains cannot cover every valid claim in full.

settlements.title: Hydromax USA Washington Job Posting Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: An equal share of the Net Settlement Fund among everyone who files a valid claim, out of a Maximum Settlement Fund of $382,500.00; the site publishes no per-person amount.

settlements.title: MG217 Coal Tar Shampoo Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $7.00 for each qualifying purchase not accompanied by a Proof of Purchase; with a Proof of Purchase, the purchase price for each qualifying purchase. Each Authorized Claimant also receives one Voucher for a $25.00 credit, capped at $50.00 in Vouchers per claimant. Class Counsel may set a further cap on the no-proof cash benefit.

settlements.title: AIS InfoSource Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Two years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete credit monitoring with one bureau credit monitoring and $1 million of financial fraud insurance; reimbursement up to $5,000.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses incurred between February 16, 2025, and October 12, 2026; and lost time of up to four hours at $20.00 per hour, for a maximum of $80.00.

settlements.title: Homebuyer Antitrust Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The Defendants have agreed to pay a combined amount of $120,334,500 as part of the Settlement.

settlements.title: CRST Expedited California Truck Driver Wage Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Class Members who do nothing receive an Individual Class Payment and an Individual PAGA Amount, if applicable, should the Court grant final approval. The settlement website does not state a fixed per-driver dollar figure.

settlements.title: Americold Logistics Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A payment of up to $25,000 for unreimbursed Documented Losses, and/or a Residual Cash Payment estimated at $200 for class members notified of both the 2020 and 2023 Data Incidents or $100 for class members notified of one of them, out of a $5,250,000 Settlement Fund. Settlement Class Members may also choose three years of Credit Monitoring in addition to the cash payment they elect.

settlements.title: DAP Health Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Documented Loss Payment of up to $5,000 with reasonable documentation; a pro rata cash payment estimated at $25 without documentation; an additional $75 California Statutory Cash Payment for California residents on July 22, 2024; plus two years of free credit and medical record monitoring. Cash payments may be reduced pro rata depending on the total value of all Valid Claims.

settlements.title: Bestway Above-Ground Pools: $15,000,000 Settlement Over Compression Straps Outside the Support Legs
settlements.estimated_payout: $15,000,000 Settlement Fund. With a Valid Proof of Purchase: a payment equal to ten percent (10%) of either the actual price paid as reflected in the Valid Proof of Purchase (e.g., receipt), or the Average Retail Price of the identified Class Product if no actual purchase price is reflected. Without Valid Proof of Purchase: a Cash Payment of Forty Dollars ($40.00).

settlements.title: Stockpile 2020 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A pro rata share of the Net Settlement Amount, divided equally amongst the Participating Class Members who submit a timely and valid Claim Form, capped at $90 (“Individual Class Payments”). The Gross Settlement Amount is $600,000.

settlements.title: Cone Health MyChart and Website Tracking Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cone Health has agreed to provide a Settlement Fund. After reasonable attorneys' fees and expenses, a service award for the Class Representative, and costs of administration are paid, the net amount of the Settlement Fund will be equally distributed to all Settlement Class Members who submit a valid and timely claim. The final amount of the payment will depend on the total number of valid claims. The site states no per-person dollar estimate.

settlements.title: Gotham Steel, Granite Stone & Bell & Howell Cookware "Non-Toxic" Marketing Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $6.00 cash payment per eligible Product, with a limit of up to 2 eligible Products per household (for a total of $12.00)

settlements.title: New York Denny's (Reveille / Top Line) Spread of Hours Wage Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The Office of the New York State Attorney General (OAG) has secured a settlement for $440,000 with Reveille Management LLC and Top Line Restaurants, Inc. to return unpaid wages. To calculate how much is due to each eligible Top Line Worker, OAG reviewed the payroll and time record data for all employees during the affected period. The OAG has sole discretion on the amount of all settlement payments. No per-person figure is published on the site.

settlements.title: Zale Delaware / Sterling Jewelers Washington Job Posting Pay Transparency Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The court-authorized Notices state an estimated payment that differs for Minimum Wage Settlement Class members and No Pay Settlement Class members. The Companies will pay a total amount that depends on how many class members claim. All Settlement Class Members who submit a timely, valid Claim Form are eligible to receive a share of the Settlement Fund, allocated pro rata up to a maximum of $5,000 per participating class member. Your exact estimated payment amount is printed on the Claim Form mailed with your Notice.

settlements.title: Xactus / Credit Plus $2.4M FCRA Credit Report Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Defendants have agreed to pay Two Million Four Hundred Thousand Dollars ($2,400,000) for the creation of a Settlement Fund. "The amount of the payments will depend on the number of claims submitted, but it is expected to be approximately $500. This estimate is based upon the typical claims rates in similar cases – the actual payment amount will depend on the actual claims rate in this case and may be lower or higher." Class Members "can choose to receive payment electronically through the website, or a check will be mailed to the address listed on the Claim Form."

settlements.title: First Baptist Church of Hammond, Indiana, Inc. Data Security Incident Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: FBC has agreed to provide a number of different cash payment options. Reimbursement for Ordinary Documented Out-of-Pocket Expenses: “If you incurred actual, documented out-of-pocket expenses due to the Data Security Incident, you can get back up to $450.00.” Reimbursement for Extraordinary Documented Out-of-Pocket Losses: “If you lost money because of identity theft or fraud, you can get back up to $4,500.00.” Lost Time: “Class Members who spent time responding to the Data Security Incident may claim up to four hours, at $20.00 per hour, for a maximum of $80.00.” Alternative Cash Payment: “Instead of any other cash payment option, you may claim a one-time $50.00 cash payment. You do not have to provide any proof or explanation to claim this payment.”

settlements.title: Vector Security Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Settlement Class Members may claim Credit Monitoring and one or more of the cash payment options. Credit Monitoring: all Class Members are eligible to enroll in one year of CyEx Financial Shield Complete, which "comes with $1 million of financial fraud insurance." Cash Payment for Out-of-Pocket Losses: "If you incurred actual, documented out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Incident, you can get back up to $2,000.00. The losses must have occurred between December 2024 and September 15, 2026." Lost Time: "Class Members who spent time responding to the Data Incident may claim up to three hours, at $20.00 per hour, for a maximum of $60.00" — this "counts toward the $2,000.00 cap on Cash Payments for Out-of-Pocket Losses." Alternative Cash Payment: "Instead of any other cash payment option, you may claim a one-time cash payment. This payment is expected to be $50.00, but may be smaller depending on the total claims filed. You do not have to provide any proof or explanation to claim this payment." "There is a cap of $185,000.00 on the Alternative Cash Payments," and if the total value exceeds that cap "everyone's payments will be reduced pro rata."

settlements.title: Volkswagen Atlas & Atlas Cross Sport Water Pump Defect Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Warranty Extension: "Effective on July 6, 2026, VWGoA will extend its New Vehicle Limited Warranties (“NVLW”) applicable to the Settlement Class Vehicles to cover eighty percent (80%) of the cost of repair or replacement (parts and labor) of a failed Main Engine Water Pump, by an authorized Volkswagen dealer, during a period of up to 8.5 years or 85,000 miles (whichever occurs first) from the In-Service Date of the Settlement Class Vehicle." Reimbursement: "you may submit a Claim to receive an eighty percent (80%) reimbursement of the paid invoice amount for said repair or replacement (parts and labor), limited to one (1) such repair or replacement per Settlement Class Vehicle. Reimbursement will also include eighty percent (80%) of the past paid expense of up to two (2) repairs or replacements (parts and labor) of the Settlement Class Vehicle’s head gasket... if the applicable repair record states that the head gasket repair or replacement was performed because the Settlement Class Vehicle had a coolant leak or low coolant level." "However, if the covered repair or replacement for which reimbursement is sought was not performed by an authorized Volkswagen dealer, then the paid invoice amount of the repair (parts and labor), from which the Settlement Class Member may receive an 80% reimbursement, shall be limited to a maximum of $820.00 for a Main Engine Water Pump repair or replacement, and $3,325.00 for a head gasket repair or replacement."

settlements.title: Moodswings Ticketing Service Charge Class Action Settlement (Mesmerica, Beautifica, Astronomica Tickets)
settlements.estimated_payout: "Settlement Class Members with Approved Claims will receive for each Moodswings ticket they purchased during the Settlement Class Period a payment in the amount of $3.37 for members of the California Settlement Class, $2.54 for members of the Colorado Settlement Class, $2.65 for members of the Connecticut Settlement Class, $3.48 for members of the Maryland Settlement Class, $7.12 for members of the New York Settlement Class, and $3.70 for members of the Tennessee Settlement Class. Settlement Class Members who submit an Approved Claim for a Cash Payment will not be eligible to receive a Discount Code." Members who do nothing instead "will receive a Discount Code for a 25% discount on one future purchase of tickets to a Moodswings show from Moodswings’s Websites."

settlements.title: Bradford-Scott Data $2,393,888.25 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: BSD will establish a Settlement Fund. Credit Monitoring: “All Class Members are eligible to enroll in three years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete. This comprehensive service comes with financial fraud insurance coverage.” Documented Monetary Losses: “If you incurred actual, documented out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Incident, you may be reimbursed for those losses. The losses must have occurred before October 7, 2026.” Pro Rata Cash Payment: “You may also claim a one-time pro rata cash payment... This payment varies depending on the total claims filed. You do not have to provide any proof or explanation to claim this payment.”

settlements.title: Furman Foods (Furmano's) October 2024 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The site states that the “PROPOSED CLASS ACTION SETTLEMENT MAY AFFECT YOUR RIGHTS, AND ENTITLE YOU TO BENEFITS AND A PAYMENT” and that “Furman Foods’ records indicate that you are a Class Member and are entitled to benefits under the Settlement.” “The only way to receive benefits from this Settlement is by submitting a valid and timely Claim Form.” The capture does not state a total fund amount or a per-person payment amount.

settlements.title: NJ Lenders Corp Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Settlement Class Members may claim Credit Monitoring and one of two Cash Payment options. Credit Monitoring: “All Settlement Class Members are eligible to enroll in one year of CyEx Financial Shield Complete... This comprehensive service comes with $1 million of financial fraud insurance”. Cash Payment A – Documented Losses: “If you incurred actual, documented out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Incident, you can get back up to $2,500.00. The losses must have occurred between August 18, 2025, and October 1, 2026.” Cash Payment B – Alternate Cash: “Instead of Cash Payment A, you may claim a one-time $40.00 cash payment. You do not have to provide any proof or explanation to claim this payment.” “You may claim only one total payment from these options.”

settlements.title: Pierce County Library System Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Settlement Class Members may submit claims for: (1) Compensation for Ordinary Losses, (2) Compensation for Extraordinary Losses, (3) Reimbursement for Attested Lost Time, (4) an Alternative Cash Payment, and/or (5) Credit Monitoring and Identity Restoration Services. Ordinary Losses: "up to a total of $250.00 per person for ordinary out-of-pocket losses incurred as a result of the Data Incident" (incurred on or after April 15, 2025, and fairly traceable to the Data Incident). Attested Lost Time: "up to $20.00 per hour for time spent remedying issues related to the Data Incident," "subject to a 4-hour cap ($80.00 maximum payment)." Credit Monitoring: "three (3) years of Credit Monitoring from one credit reporting bureau and Identity Restoration Services with $1,000,000.00 identity theft insurance with no deductible." Reimbursement for Monetary Losses, Reimbursement for Attested Lost Time, and the Alternative Cash Payment are "subject to a $385,000.00 aggregate cap"; if approved claims exceed that, "the benefits will be reduced, pro rata."

settlements.title: System Pavers $350,544 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: System Pavers will establish a Settlement Fund of $350,544.00. Credit Monitoring Services: "All Class Members are eligible to enroll in three (3) years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete. This comprehensive service comes with $1 million of financial fraud insurance." Cash Payments: Documented Losses "you can get back up to $3,000.00" for "actual, documented, unreimbursed out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Security Incident"; Lost Time "up to four (4) hours, at $20.00 per hour, for a maximum of $80.00"; Alternative Cash Payment "expected to be $100.00 for California residents, and $80.00 for residents of all other states. The payment may be larger or smaller depending on the total claims filed."

settlements.title: Equinox, Inc. Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "Submitting a Claim Form is the only way that you can receive any of the Settlement Class Member Benefits provided by this Settlement, including Credit Monitoring and cash compensation." Under the Settlement, Equinox has agreed to pay: "(1) Settlement Class Member Benefits for Settlement Class Members who submit Valid Claims; (2) attorneys' fees, and costs awarded by the Court to Class Counsel; (3) Service Awards awarded by the Court to the Class Representatives and (4) all Settlement Administration costs." The capture does not state a total fund amount or a per-person dollar figure.

settlements.title: Eisner Advisory Group $1,050,000 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The Defendant has agreed to pay a total of $1,050,000 to settle the Action. settlements.title: OnePoint Patient Care $2,115,000 Data Incident Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "Cash Payment A – Documented Losses: You may submit a Claim Form and provide reasonable documentation for losses related to the Data Incident for up to $3,500 per Settlement Class Member; OR Cash Payment B – Alternate Cash: Instead of Cash Payment A, without providing documentation, you may submit a Claim Form to receive an alternate Cash Payment in the estimated amount of $100; Your Cash Payment may be subject to a pro rata (a legal term meaning equal share) increase or decrease depending upon the total value of all Valid Claims. Information Security Enhancements: Defendant is implementing additional security measures following the Data Incident." Total fund: "A $2,115,000 settlement has been reached".

settlements.title: Clay-Platte Family Medicine Clinic $1,000,000 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The Clay-Platte defendants agreed to establish a fund of $1,000,000.00. Reimbursement for Documented Losses: "If you spent money or incurred losses as a result of the Data Breach, you may submit a claim for reimbursement of up to $15,000. Supporting documentation for losses related to the data security incident is required." Cash Fund Payment: "In lieu of submitting a claim for a Documented Loss Payment, you may elect to receive a Cash Fund Payment. Cash Fund Payments will be distributed on a pro rata basis... The amount of any payment is not guaranteed and will depend on the number of approved Documented Loss claims and other required expenses." Free Medical and Credit Monitoring Services: "You can submit a claim to enroll in three years of CyEx Medical Shield Total, a medical and three-bureau credit monitoring service designed to protect against medical identity theft and fraud." Business Practice Commitments for at least five years following the effective date of the Settlement.

settlements.title: National Tenant Network $1,625,000 Eviction Postcard FCRA Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A settlement fund of no less than $1,625,000 has been agreed upon, which, after deducting attorneys’ fees, costs, an incentive award to the Class Representative (Vanessa Clermont) and settlement administration costs, will be used to pay Class Members who submit Valid Claims. Each Class Member will receive an equal share of the Settlement Fund. Cash payment amounts will depend on the total number of Valid Claims filed by Class Members and the amount of money remaining in the fund after making the deductions listed above.

settlements.title: Permobil SpeedControl Dial $4.1M Defective Product Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "The Settlement provides for a Cash Settlement Fund in the amount of $4,100,000.00 be used to pay all Settlement Benefits, Settlement Administration Costs, Class Representative Service Payments, and Plaintiffs Counsel's Fees and Expenses." "The Net Settlement Fund will be allocated, firstly, to each Authorized Claimant who submits a valid claim for Repair/Replacement Reimbursement up to a maximum of $1000.00 per claim, and not more than $100,000 total. After allocation for Repair/Replacement Reimbursements, the Net Cash Settlement Fund will be allocated pro rata to each Authorized Claimant who submits a Claim for a Cash Benefit." Payment methods: PayPal, Venmo, ACH transfer, Zelle, Virtual Mastercard, or check.

settlements.title: Doxim $5.5M Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cash Payment A – Documented Losses: You may submit a Claim Form and provide reasonable documentation for fraud or identity theft losses that can be reasonably traced to the Data Incident for up to $5,000 per Settlement Class Member; OR Cash Payment B – Alternate Cash Payment: Instead of Cash Payment A, without providing documentation, you may submit a Claim Form to receive a Cash Payment in the estimated amount of $100; AND Credit Monitoring: In addition to Cash Payment A or Cash Payment B, you may also submit a Claim Form to receive one year of free Credit Monitoring. Your Cash Payment may be subject to a pro rata (a legal term meaning equal share) increase or decrease depending upon the total value of all Valid Claims.

settlements.title: HCF Management Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "All Settlement Class Members are eligible to claim three (3) years of free credit monitoring with $1,000,000.00 in fraud insurance. In addition, Class Members can also receive monetary relief including: (1) reimbursement for loss of time compensated at $20.00 per hour up to 4 hours ($80.00 dollars total); (2) reimbursement for documented out-of-pocket expenses and financial losses up to $400.00 per claimant; and (3) reimbursement for documented Extraordinary Losses up to $4,000.00 per claimant; or (4) an alternative cash payment in the form of $35.00 per claimant."

settlements.title: O'Reilly Automotive TCPA Text Message Class Action Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "If you submit a valid claim on time, you will receive a cash payment of up to $22.00 per person. This amount may be reduced on a pro rata basis." Per the FAQ: "O’Reilly Automotive has agreed to pay Settlement Payments with estimated value of $22.00 per person for Approved Claims. This value may be reduced pro rata so that (i) any service award, (ii) costs of settlement administration, (iii) any attorney fees and costs, and (iv) the cash payments for all timely and valid claims by Settlement Class Members do not exceed the Aggregate Cap of $18,842,577. Only one claim per Settlement Class Member per telephone number will be validated and deemed an Approved Claim."

settlements.title: Palm Beach Tan $2.5M Unwanted Text Message Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Each Settlement Class Member who submits a Valid Claim Form is entitled to up to $1,500 per each Post-Stop Message as reflected in the text message data. Each Settlement Class Member will receive an equal amount per Post-Stop Message. Cash payment amounts will depend on the total number of Valid Claims filed by Settlement Class Members and the amount of money remaining in the fund after making the deductions listed above.

settlements.title: WVU Medicine / CIOX Medical Records Copy Fee Class Action Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Class Members who submit timely and valid Proof(s) of Claim will be deemed eligible to receive payment or the “Settlement Benefit” of the difference between the Per-Page Rate charged by CIOX to produce copies of the medical records in response to a qualifying request for medical records and the Settlement Rate of $0.14 per page. Patient Requests: $0.40 per-page: December 1, 2010, through July 15, 2011; $0.75 per-page: July 15, 2011 through June 30, 2014; $0.49 per-page: June 30, 2014 through February 8, 2016; $0.39 per-page: February 8, 2016 through August 23, 2016; and $0.12 per-page: August 23, 2016 through July 5, 2017. Non-Patient Requests: $0.40 per-page: December 1, 2010, through July 15, 2011; $0.75 per-page: July 15, 2011 through June 30, 2014; and $0.55 per-page: June, 2014 through July 5, 2017. Only one claim and only one Settlement Benefit may be paid per qualifying request for copies of medical records. Checks issued to Class Members will be void one-hundred and eighty (180) days after issuance.

settlements.title: Forbes Media $10M California Website Tracking Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Under the proposed Settlement, Forbes will pay $10,000,000 into a Settlement Fund to resolve the lawsuit. After paying Administration Costs, any Court-awarded Attorneys’ Fees and Costs and Incentive Awards, the remaining balance of the Settlement Fund will be used for payments to Settlement Class Members. Each Settlement Class Member who files a valid Proof of Claim form will receive a pro rata (proportional) share of the remaining balance of the Settlement Fund after costs, fees, and awards are deducted.

settlements.title: State Farm Louisiana Total Loss Purchasing Fees Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: State Farm shall pay Settlement Class Members $28.39 in satisfaction of applicable Purchasing Fees to eligible Settlement Class Members who timely submit a valid claim.

settlements.title: Anixter Center Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Settlement Class Members may claim Identity-Theft Protection and Credit Monitoring and one or more of the cash payment options. Identity-Theft Protection And Credit Monitoring. All Class Members are eligible to enroll in one year of CyEx Identity Defense Complete. This comprehensive service comes with $1 million in identity theft insurance. Expense Reimbursement. If you incurred actual, documented out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Incident, you can get back up to $5,000.00. The losses must have occurred between July 17, 2023, and October 19, 2026. Lost-Time Reimbursement. Class Members who spent time responding to the Data Incident may claim up to three hours, at $17.50 per hour, for a maximum of $52.50. Alternative Cash Payment. Instead of any other cash payment option, you may claim a one-time $50.00 cash payment. You do not have to provide any proof or explanation to claim this payment.

settlements.title: HireVue $3.75M Illinois Video Interview Biometrics Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "Defendant has agreed to create a $3,750,000.00 Settlement Fund for the Class Members. All Settlement Class Members are entitled to submit a Claim Form to receive a payment out of the Settlement Fund. If the Settlement is approved, each Settlement Class Member who submits a timely Claim Form that is deemed valid will be entitled to an equal payment paid out of the Settlement Fund after payment is made for administrative expenses, attorneys' fees and expenses, and Class Representatives' service awards. The amount of each valid claimant's payment is estimated to be $150.00, but the exact amount is unknown at this time and depends on several factors, including how many valid claims are submitted. The Settlement Administrator will issue a check or electronic payment to each Class Member who submits a valid Claim Form following the final approval of the Settlement. All checks issued to Settlement Class Members will expire and become void 75 days after they are issued."

settlements.title: Davison Design $30,000 Washington Text Message Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Davison has agreed to create a $30,000.00 Settlement Fund. The amount of each payment cannot be determined until after the claim deadline. The payment amount will depend on the number of timely and valid claims and the deductions approved by the Court. No payments will be issued unless the Court approves the Settlement and the Settlement becomes final.

settlements.title: Crossroads Trading $600,000 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The Settlement provides Settlement Class Members with credit monitoring services, payments for out-of-pocket losses, and alternative cash payments, subject to the submission of certain information and documentation. Credit Monitoring Services: Settlement Class Members may submit a Claim Form to receive two years of complimentary three-bureau credit monitoring services. Documented Loss Payment: Settlement Class Members may submit a Claim Form to receive up to $5,000 for a Documented Loss Payment. Alternative Cash Payment: Settlement Class Members who do not file a claim for a Documented Loss Payment may submit a Claim Form to receive an Alternative Cash Payment currently estimated to be $25. Settlement Class Members who are residents of California or who resided in California at any point between February 15, 2025, and October 13, 2026, may submit a Claim Form to receive a California Statutory Cash Payment currently estimated to be $100. Crossroads has agreed to pay $600,000 into a Settlement Fund.

settlements.title: Anthem $3.625M Proton Beam Therapy Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: "Anthem has agreed to pay a total of $3,625,000 to settle the Action. After deducting Court-approved attorneys' fees and costs, ervice awards, and the costs of administering the Settlement, the balance will be used to make payments to Settlement Class Members who submit valid Claim Forms." "The Settlement Administrator shall determine the Settlement Payment based on the Settlement Class Member's total Qualifying Payment(s). Qualifying Payment(s) means the total amount of out-of-pocket payments made by a Settlement Class Member for PBRT for the treatment of prostate cancer (meaning treatments were not covered by insurance)."

settlements.title: Arrowhead Regional Computing Consortium Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Class Members who submit valid and timely claims are eligible to receive two (2) years of 3-bureau credit monitoring as well as reimbursement for time spent addressing the Data Incident at a rate of $20.00 per hour for up to four (4) hours (i.e., not to exceed $80.00 per Settlement Class Member).

settlements.title: Coleman Professional Services Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Class Members are eligible to submit claims for identity protection services and cash payments of roughly $70 (assuming a claim rate of 10% of the roughly 51,889-person Settlement Class), which will be pro rata increased or decreased based on the money still remaining in the Settlement Fund at the time of payment. In addition to these benefits, you are eligible to be reimbursed for any documented losses or expenses (up to $5,000 total) that you can demonstrate are traceable to the Data Incident.

settlements.title: USA Clinics Group $574,350 TCPA Text Message Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: USA Clinics Group agrees to make a capped settlement fund available to pay Settlement Class Members who submit valid Claim Forms; pay notice and administration costs; pay attorneys' fees and costs awarded to Class Counsel; and any service award approved for the class representative. Settlement Class Members may only submit one Claim Form, which will cover all text messages (up to three) to any of their telephone number(s). If the Settlement Fund is insufficient to pay the full per-message amount for all approved claims, the per-message amount will be uniformly reduced on a pro rata basis.

settlements.title: Albany Gastroenterology Consultants Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Settlement Class Members will automatically receive an enrollment code for Credit Monitoring and may claim one of the Cash Payment options. Credit Monitoring: All Class Members are eligible to enroll in two years of CyEx Medical Shield Complete. This comprehensive service comes with medical identity theft insurance coverage. Cash Payment A – Compensation for Out-of-Pocket Expenses: “If you incurred actual, documented out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Breach, you can get back your documented losses. The losses must have occurred before October 5, 2026.” Cash Payment B – Alternative Cash Payment: “Instead of Cash Payment A, you may claim a one-time cash payment. This payment's amount depends on the total number of claims filed. You do not have to provide any proof or explanation to claim this payment.” “There is a total cap on these cash benefits, split between a cap for Cash Payment A and a cap for Cash Payment B.”

settlements.title: People Data Labs $6,362,167 Colorado Privacy Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: PDL will establish a Settlement Fund of $6,362,167.00. After deduction of costs of notice and settlement administration, any award of attorneys’ fees, litigation costs, and any Service Award for the Class Representative, the remaining Settlement Fund money will be divided equally between everyone who files a valid and timely claim. The specific payment you receive will depend on how many other Class Members file valid and timely claims.

settlements.title: Community Realty Management Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Class Members are eligible to enroll in Credit Monitoring and one out of the two Cash Payment options. This payment is expected to be $20.00 but may be larger or smaller depending on the total claims filed.” “There is a Settlement Cap of $200,000.00 on these cash benefits.”

settlements.title: Mary Black Health System $2.25M Medical Billing Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: “You may be eligible to receive a pro rata share of the Net Settlement Fund based on the Settlement of the Lawsuit.” The Settlement is described as “a Class Action Settlement Valued at $2.25 Million.” “If your claim is confirmed and the Court approves the settlement, you will then receive your pro-rata share of the benefits of the Settlement.”

settlements.title: City of Detroit Water Rate Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A proposed settlement has been reached with the City of Detroit. Each class member receives a Pro Rata Share of the Net Settlement Fund. settlements.title: Dairy Farmers of America Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: This payment is expected to be $55.00. There is an aggregate cap of $475,000.00 on these cash payments; if claims exceed the cap, payments are reduced pro rata. Class members may instead claim reimbursement of up to $4,500.00 for documented out-of-pocket losses. settlements.title: Bayhealth Pixel Privacy Settlement

settlements.title: Heritage South Credit Union Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: One year of CyEx Financial Shield Total credit monitoring with $1 million of financial fraud insurance; Documented Losses up to $2,000.00 for out-of-pocket losses between February 12, 2025 and October 5, 2026; Lost Time up to four hours, at $20.00 per hour, for a maximum of $80.00. settlements.title: ZOLL Medical Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $3,500,000.00 Settlement Fund. settlements.title: Ernst & Young / Bank of America MOVEit Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $2,500,000 settlement fund; "reimbursement of qualifying documented ordinary losses up to $2,500 and reimbursement of qualifying documented extraordinary losses up to $10,000" or an "alternative cash payment of $100," plus "two (2) years of identity theft protection services"

settlements.title: RealPage Rental Software Antitrust Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: $359,925,000 Settlement Fund; "There will be no payments at this time. If the Court enters Final Approval of these Settlements, money will be distributed at a later date."

settlements.title: Tesla Supercharger Idle Fee Class Action Settlement (California)
settlements.estimated_payout: Refund of all Supercharger 'Idle Fees' paid (amount determined from Tesla's records); a $50.00 cash payment if Supercharging was disabled for less than 30 days or a $350.00 cash payment if disabled for 30 or more days; a $10.00 payment for class members who no longer own an eligible vehicle. settlements.title: Aidvantage TCPA Robocall Settlement (Knox v. Maximus Education)
settlements.estimated_payout: Per the settlement site: "you will receive a share of the settlement fund after certain amounts are deducted" — an equal pro-rata share of the $3,000,000 fund, estimated in the FAQ at $500 to $1,000 per approved claimant after notice/administration costs, attorneys' fees (up to one-third of the fund), and litigation expenses are deducted.

settlements.title: Scale AI $12.5M California Wage-and-Hour Settlement (McKinney v. Scale AI)
settlements.estimated_payout: The net settlement amount is shared by "dividing the Net Settlement Amount by the total number of Class Workweeks worked by all Participating Class Members during the Class Period, and multiplying the result by each Participating Class Member's own Class Workweeks."

settlements.title: Anthropic Copyright Settlement (Bartz v. Anthropic)
settlements.estimated_payout: Anthropic has agreed to establish a non-reversionary Settlement Fund. The Settlement provides payments per work (not per Class Member), plus interest earned on the Settlement fund, less the Court-approved costs and fees.

settlements.title: Travelers New Mexico Underinsured Motorist (UIM) Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Class members other than wrongful-death claimants may elect either payment under a premium formula — 29% of all UIM premiums paid during the Class Period — or payment under a claim formula, in which the UIM claim is readjusted without the UIM offset applied (depending on your damages you may receive less than the offset, or nothing). settlements.title: 700Credit Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Cash Payment A – Documented Losses: reimbursement of up to $2,500.00 per Settlement Class Member with reasonable documentation; or Cash Payment B – Flat Cash: a flat cash payment in the estimated amount of $50.00 with no documentation required. Payments are subject to pro rata increase or decrease based on claims received. All class members also received an activation code for two years of credit monitoring in their notice.

settlements.title: Teofilo v. C-Plant Federal Credit Union
settlements.estimated_payout: C-Plant has agreed to pay into a Settlement Fund. Each Class Member will be paid from the Net Settlement Fund on a pro rata basis, based on the amount of applicable Challenged Fees paid by the Class Member.

settlements.title: AT&T Washington Meal and Rest Break Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: The settlement includes a total payment by Defendants of $1,750,000 (Common Fund).

settlements.title: Washington Commercial Email Settlement (Aaland v. Costco)
settlements.estimated_payout: Costco will pay $14,000,000 into a settlement fund. settlements.title: Generic Drugs End-Payer Antitrust Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Court-approved settlement funds: a settlement with Sandoz Inc. and Fougera Pharmaceuticals Inc.; a settlement with Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, Inc. and Taro Pharmaceuticals U.S.A., Inc.; and two settlements with Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc., Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd., Satish Mehta, and Apotex Corp. settlements.title: University of St. Thomas Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $500.00 for ordinary losses and up to $4,500.00 for extraordinary losses (each with third-party documentation); a $100.00 payment related to Sensitive Personal Information (with third-party documentation); plus three (3) years of one-bureau credit monitoring and identity theft protection with at least $1,000,000.00 in identity theft insurance. Alternatively, class members may claim a $50.00 cash payment in lieu of documented reimbursement or credit monitoring.

settlements.title: iQ Credit Union Overdraft & NSF Fee Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: iQ Credit Union will pay into a Settlement Fund and forgive charged-off Challenged Fees that were assessed but not paid. Payments and account credits come from the Net Settlement Fund based on a percentage of the applicable fees each member paid — pro rata, so a Class Member who paid more in applicable fees receives more than one who paid less (after court-approved attorneys' fees of up to 1/3, administration costs, and a service award).

settlements.title: LifeStance Health Pixel Data Privacy Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Pro rata cash payment from a non-reversionary Settlement Fund of $3,027,874.44 — the Settlement Subclass 1 Fund ($1,203,405.00, for patients who booked via the online booking tool) plus the Settlement Subclass 2 Fund ($1,824,469.44, for all other patients) — less court-awarded attorneys' fees (up to 33% requested), service awards (up to $2,500 per class representative), and administration expenses. Allocation is per claimant, not per appointment or per website visit.

settlements.title: Liberty Mutual 401(k) Plan Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: A $13,400,000 Qualified Settlement Account will be established; individual distributions are allocated under a Court-approved Plan of Allocation, and no per-person amounts are listed. Current participants receive automatic distributions into their existing Plan accounts.

settlements.title: Legends Hospitality Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: From an $812,900.00 settlement fund, claimants may choose either reimbursement of documented out-of-pocket losses up to $5,000.00 (for losses incurred November 9, 2024 through August 19, 2026, such as identity theft losses, credit monitoring fees, ID replacement, and postage) OR an alternate cash payment estimated at $200.00 (amount varies by claim volume). All class members are also eligible for three years of CyEx Financial Shield Total credit monitoring, which includes $1 million in financial fraud insurance.

settlements.title: Healthcare Services Group Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: HCSG will pay $3,000,000 into a Settlement Fund. Class members may claim reimbursement of up to $5,000 for Documented Monetary Losses reasonably related to the Data Incident, three (3) years of one-bureau Credit Monitoring services (including dark web monitoring and identity theft insurance coverage of up to $1,000,000), and a Pro Rata Cash Payment of the remaining Settlement Fund balance divided among claimants after deductions.

settlements.title: Excel Fitness Management Data Breach Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Up to $4,000.00 for actual, documented out-of-pocket losses due to the Data Incident (incurred January 17, 2025 through September 21, 2026); lost time at $25.00 per hour for up to 3 hours (maximum $75.00); an Alternative Cash Payment expected to be $50.00 with no proof required (amount may vary with total claims); plus two years of CyEx Financial Shield Complete credit monitoring with $1 million identity theft insurance. Benefits are subject to an aggregate cap of $175,000.00 and may be reduced proportionally if exceeded.

settlements.title: BrandSafway Washington Job Postings Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Estimated payment of $1,632.11 per class member per the settlement website; the FAQ states payments are calculated as equal shares among all valid claimants and that your exact estimated amount appears on the Claim Form mailed with your Notice. Payments are characterized as non-wage damages (1099).

settlements.title: Emanate Health Medical Center Privacy Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: Each valid claimant receives a pro rata share of the Net Settlement Fund; the exact per-person amount depends on how many class members submit valid claims.

settlements.title: Equifax Duplicate Collection Accounts FCRA Settlement
settlements.estimated_payout: All Settlement Class Members receive complimentary access to the Equifax Complete credit monitoring product for six (6) months (valued at $59.70, with up to $500,000 in coverage for certain identity-theft-related out-of-pocket expenses) without filing a claim. Class members who file a claim affirming they were harmed by the duplicate reporting can receive a cash payment from a $2,200,000 Settlement Fund; the payment depends on how many valid claims are received and is expected to be up to $600.00.

settlements.title: Dovenmuehle Phone Payment Fees Settlement
